Hardware.c adapts the read-only SMC request layout, sensor-key discovery, and
IOReport sampling approach from https://github.com/vladkens/macmon (main branch,
retrieved October 31, 2026). Copyright and MIT permission notice are preserved
in macmon-LICENSE. The Mac app does not bundle or execute the macmon application.

These hardware interfaces are undocumented and may change between macOS or
chip versions. Missing or invalid readings remain unavailable.
